messages:
Alex: Quick sync — field teams reported a few recurring constraints for on‑prem VPC packaging that we need to prioritize for Q3. Short thread to align on launch gates and which asks go into MVP vs follow-ups.
Priya: +1. Can we list the biggest blockers from customers? I have notes from Acme Health and GreenBank.
Jamal: Top ones: 1) airgap install + delta updates, 2) customer-managed peering vs NAT traversal, 3) key rotation + KMS integration requirements, 4) signed bundle verification.
Kaya: Also network handoff UX: netops teams want an operator-mode that requires minimal firewall changes. They hate long preflight checklists.
Alex: Good. Proposed segmentation: MVP must include online VPC install + signed image verification + simple KMS integration. Airgap and operator-mode are alpha for targeted customers.
Priya: For airgap, field asks for delta-only bundles (not full image every time). That affects our packaging pipeline. Might need blockers in the build infra to produce patches.
Jamal: Technical note: delta bundles + image signing implies we need a reproducible build manifest and a small delta applicator on host. Suggest we ship a delta-applier container that validates signatures and applies filesystem diffs.
Kaya: On networking: customers either want IP peering (BGP/VPN) or an outbound-only option that uses a persistent TLS tunnel to our control plane. Outbound-only is easier for them, but has operational limits (e.g., egress throughput).
Priya: Agreement: MVP supports outbound-control-plane tunnel + documented peering playbook. Mark peering as enterprise-only with >90% test coverage in lab.
Alex: Launch criteria checklist proposal: 1) Install/run success on three reference topologies (AWS VPC with private subnets, GCP VPC, baremetal w/ NAT), 2) automated signed-bundle verification, 3) KMS integration tests (rotate keys w/o downtime), 4) rollback path tested, 5) runbook and playbook for netops.
Jamal: Can we add latency and token-cost SLOs for the outbound tunnel? Customer concerns about adding roundtrip and throughput throttling.
Kaya: Add SLO: median p50+ p95 per-request proxy overhead <30ms for within-region, and throttling failover mode when we detect tail congestion. Document fallback to hosted inference.
Priya: Implementation constraints: to support KMS/HSM we need an abstraction layer in the installer for key endpoints and a config schema. I can draft the schema. Also we need a migration path for existing private customers to opt into new KMS integration.
Alex: Good. Prioritization vote — keepable as MVP items: signed bundle verification, outbound tunnel (with alerts), KMS add-on, basic rollback. Airgap/delta, operator-helm UX, peering automation into roadmap after GA. Anyone object?
Jamal: No objection. But flag: some bigger customers (financial) will push for peering and airgap early. Recommend we prepare an "expedite" checklist and a pre-sales technical assessment form.
Kaya: +1. Also add image signing with key rotation docs for SOC/compliance teams. They want evidence of verification in audits.
Priya: I'll turn the checklist into a short PRD and slot implementation epics: packaging infra (build/delta), installer (tunnel + KMS), security (signing + verification), netops docs. ETA: draft PRD by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: deploy status — staging installer v0.3 deployed to testbed-3. Smoke tests: install success 9/10, KMS rotation simulated, bundle signature verified.
Alex: Nice. Next steps: Priya to PRD, Jamal to spike delta-applier and publish notes, Kaya to outline netops playbook. We'll reconvene next Wed for readiness gating. Tagging @channel for visibility. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Adding a short customer communication plan for GA that includes known limitations (no peering automation yet) and recommended network configs.
Jamal: I'll start a one-pager for sales with "expedite checklist" and estimated uplift for peering/airgap professional services.
Kaya: I'll draft the runbook and preflight script that fails fast with clear remediation steps for netops teams.
Alex: Great — thanks everyone. If any field team needs immediate escalation, DM me.
